blocks.text: PARIS, France — Hundreds of thousands of striking workers protested across France on Thursday against the rising cost of living following weeks of youth-led demonstrations, with police firing tear gas as clashes broke out in some cities. The marches come as the eurozone’s second-largest economy battles to redress its dire finances, six months ahead of elections
